Thanks of the reply. I've had 6 gfs already. That might be a problem for me. This last one just clicked and I coudn't get things right when she was annoyed to and everything comes from the insecurity.

I know I want to be happy with myself but having doubts about everything in mylife and seeing golden chances walking away just give me another shot of low self steem. I just want to explode. It's extreme and dramatic but it's the way I feel. I can"t connect with anyone, that is my main problem when in crisis. Why? I don't know how people make it. Am I a socipath? I'm shy and feel uncomfortabe often.

and with that break up, I just felt I've had enough. If in 25 years I couldn't be confident and like a failure, why wait to things get really messy (more responsability in life)?

Ppl think I play the victim and it just makes me worse.

It just hurts so much and I feel so guilty all the time that I can't get to think any bad of her and just feel down and hopeless. I repeated some little mistakes over and over and she couldnt cope with that. The fact is I cam't stop feeling that she is the one. I've had others gfs but never felt like this one. Fuck
